topics.title: Vica+Empa (ASi+SGLT2i) — EASi-KIDNEY Trial Start-up Delay (CKD) and CVRR FDA Meeting Cancellation

background.text: EASi-KIDNEY trial start-up delayed continuously; global evidence Lead to meet with Oxford to discuss in next few weeks. Meeting with national coordinator Prof. Fangfang Hou scheduled at investigator meeting on 19 Jul.
background.quote:
EASi-KIDNEY trail start-up delayed continuously, global evidence Lead  will be meeting with Oxford to discuss in the next few weeks.
Meeting with national coordinator of EASi-SYNC – Prof. Fangfang Hou at investigator meeting on 19th Jul.

background.text: CVRR: FDA meeting canceled after initial positive feedback; final protocol archived on 5th May. Meeting with National Coordinator Prof. Yida Tang scheduled on 5 Jun.
background.quote:
FDA meeting canceled after initial positive feedback, final protocol archived on 5th May
Meeting with National Coordinator-Prof. Yida Tang is scheduled  on 5th Jun.
